csv_project_name: AE Services for FY26 AEDC Arnold AFB
csv_scope_of_work: The A-E services required to support Arnold AFB are services meeting the definition of A-E Services as defined in 40 U.S.C. 1101 and FAR 2.101. Services include, but are not limited to, engineering studies, investigations, tests, evaluations, consultations, drawings, renovations/repair projects, such as , building renovations and additions, new construction, preparation of project definition and programming documents, charrettes, preparation of the technical portions of design-build solicitations, value engineering studies, environmental permit applications, geotechnical reports and reviews, construction phase support, and facility condition assessments. The work will be for the Arnold Engineering and Development Complex (AEDC) at Arnold AFB, TN.
